mapper.select:
select distinct on (ft.meta_info::json ->>'fileUrl') ft.meta_info::json ->>'fileUrl' as fileUrl, ft.file_url as errorUrl, ft.file_name as errorName, ft.id as taskId, ft.type, ft.event, ft.create_time from file_task ft
ft.is_deleted = false and
ft.meta_info LIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{fileUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text), '%')
order by ft.meta_info::json ->>'fileUrl', ft.create_time desc
